intake.title: Intake
intake.description: Always on. Runs first on every request and rewrites it into an internal prompt that skill selection reads. Not selected by description match.

ux-constitution-core.title: The UX Constitution (Core)
ux-constitution-core.description: Foundational UX rules for interaction, psychology, perception, and accessibility — core thresholds only.

ux-constitution-extended.title: The UX Constitution (Extended)
ux-constitution-extended.description: Extended UX constitution with edge cases, detailed examples, and advanced rules.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Ground a design decision in real evidence the partner can provide or confirm.

product-direction.title: Product direction
product-direction.description: Set the overall design direction for an open-ended product ask. Offer two or three candidate directions, recommend one, and let the partner choose.

design-pipeline.title: The Design Pipeline
design-pipeline.description: Turn a design request into a sequence of decisions. Guided default (6 stops). Express only when partner says 'you decide'.

design-pipeline-fast.title: The Design Pipeline (Fast)
design-pipeline-fast.description: Express-only design pipeline for experienced partners. Three stops: Frame → Structure → Surface. Opt-in only.

design-record.title: Design record
design-record.description: Keep the project's living design record and the DESIGN_GAPS.md register.

design-handoff.title: Design handoff
design-handoff.description: Write the handoff spec for an accepted design: flow, layout, components and states, copy, interaction, motion, and tokens, by reference to the design system.

ux-writing.title: UX Writing
ux-writing.description: Write, rewrite, name, or audit interface copy. Covers voice, tone, buttons, labels, headings, empty states, errors, success, hints, destructive confirmation.

user-flow.title: User flow
user-flow.description: Decide how someone finishes one job. Covers the main success path, branches, empty and error recovery, cancel, and exit.

information-architecture.title: Information architecture
information-architecture.description: Organize where something lives. Covers pages, steps, sections, and navigation labels.

screen-composition.title: Screen composition
screen-composition.description: Compose one screen from the project's design system. Covers regions, what leads, reading and focus order, component mapping, tokens, states per region, and reflow.
